text:
jess_ae: Heads up — Helios TeleMed is kicking off an APAC pilot next week and asked for egress allowlist + a temporary rate-limit increase for 72h to validate telehealth transcripts. Renewal conversation in ~30d flagged as medium risk if performance dips. Can we fast-track?
maria_cs: Thanks for the heads up. Do we have exact IPs and regions? Which endpoints will they hit (api vs ingest)?
jess_ae: They listed 3 CIDRs (ap-sg + ap-northeast-1 ranges). Primary traffic to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Customer asks for 2x current rate window for 72h starting 2024-07-12 00:00 UTC.
ryan_infra: I can take the allowlist + temp RL, but need CIDRs and an owner to approve transient policy. Also need to ensure Dedicated pools in APAC have capacity headroom.
infra_bot: Ticket created: #INC-2149 — "Helios APAC allowlist + temp rate-lift". Assigned to ryan_infra. ETA initial review: 2h.
maria_cs: I'll sync with Helios to confirm exact start+end and non-prod vs prod traffic split. Also capture post-pilot feedback items (latency, errors, cost anomalies).
oliver_support: FYI we saw a similar burst from Meridian that caused a brief throttling before we added a short RL bump. Recommend setting a kill-switch and alert threshold at 80% of new window.
amanda_ops: Approving transient policy as long as we have the kill-switch and a rollback plan. Please add a note to the renewal playbook about this pilot (customer success + AE follow-up).
ryan_infra: CIDRs received via email: 203.57.120.0/22, 103.14.200.0/24, 43.230.64.0/18. Applying allowlist to ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 edges. Config snippet I will run: ```sh
redwood infra allowlist add --cidr 203.57.120.0/22 --regions ap-southeast-1,ap-northeast-1 --reason "Helios pilot"
redwood rl update --customer helios-telemed --multiplier 2 --window 72h --notify "cs@redwood"
```
ryan_infra: Will set alert: if token QPS > 80% new cap for 15m -> slack @oncall and auto-rollback.
maria_cs: Please capture a short post-mortem template and send to Helios after pilot ends. We'll ask for feedback on latency, hallucination rates, and any integration friction.
jess_ae: I'll handle renewal check-in and include usage delta and pilot outcomes. Also adding a quick enablement doc for Helios engineers on endpoint best practices.
infra_bot: Change applied in staging (ap-southeast-1). Prod change scheduled for 2024-07-12 00:00 UTC pending final confirmation from maria_cs.
maria_cs: Confirmed start time with customer, prod go-ahead. Thanks team — I'll update the renewal notes and follow-up template after pilot completes. :thumbsup:
